shared_elements: carved relief motifs on stone surface
justification: Both depict human forms rendered in low relief on stone, and both include a disc-like circular motif (a chariot wheel and shield in A, a ring on the back of the figure in B), but this is generic. A shows a narrative multi-figure siege scene in strict profile with archers, a siege engine and crenellated architecture arranged in horizontal registers, whereas B is a single monolithic frontal head-and-torso figure with isolated abstract emblems on its back, sharing no narrative, relationship or arrangement conventions.
